description: Na₄Bi₂O₅ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with four NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 7°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.56 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids, edges with five NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ square pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 16°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.61 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ square pyramid, edges with five NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ square pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 7°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.59 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.48 Å. There are two inequivalent Bi sites. In the first Bi site, Bi is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.44 Å. In the second Bi site, Bi is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.13 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four Na and one Bi atom to form distorted ONa₄Bi trigonal bipyramids that share corners with five ONa₄Bi₂ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₃Bi₂ square pyramid, edges with four ONa₄Bi₂ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Bi₂ square pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₄Bi trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 10-85°. In the second O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Bi atoms to form ONa₄Bi₂ octahedra that share corners with three ONa₄Bi₂ octahedra, corners with three equivalent ONa₃Bi₂ square pyramids,  a cornercorner with one ONa₄Bi trigonal bipyramid, edges with six ONa₄Bi₂ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Bi₂ square pyramid, and edges with two equivalent ONa₄Bi trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 5-7°. In the third O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Bi atom to form ONa₅Bi octahedra that share corners with three ONa₄Bi₂ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₃Bi₂ square pyramid, corners with two equivalent ONa₄Bi trigonal bipyramids, edges with six ONa₄Bi₂ octahedra, edges with two equivalent ONa₃Bi₂ square pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₄Bi trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 5-19°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Bi atom to form ONa₅Bi octahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₅Bi octahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₃Bi₂ square pyramid, corners with two equivalent ONa₄Bi trigonal bipyramids, edges with eight ONa₄Bi₂ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Bi₂ square pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₄Bi trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 7°. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to three Na and two equivalent Bi atoms to form distorted ONa₃Bi₂ square pyramids that share corners with five ONa₄Bi₂ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₄Bi trigonal bipyramid, edges with four ONa₄Bi₂ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Bi₂ square pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₄Bi trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 9-88°.
